Confirm the prices are final consumer prices (PAngV), and whether each package gets its own booking link in Pabau. All buttons use BOOKING_URL for now.

items.text: Laboratory fees are billed directly by your local lab.
Medication and supplement costs are not included.
Prescriptions are issued where medically indicated and legally permitted in your country.
All 12-week programmes include secure chat with your doctors, with a reply within 48 hours on working days.
